svg.title: Opening areas at one common length scale
svg.desc: Reference: one circle, diameter five quarters of a source digit. Comparison: 1 separate circles, each diameter 5/2 digits. Total comparison area is 4 times the reference. Circles are separate openings, not a packing diagram.
